purpose: Prospectively execute the unchanged v54 document-contrastive and role-closure mechanism on Doc2Dial v0.9 wOOD after correcting only the old-version turn-container adapter and aligning empty-reference labels with the official README.

pre_registration_source_access_disclosur.schema_information_observed: Top-level keys, container types, turn field names, document dictionary keys and aggregate counts only.

v56_schema_corrections: Accept turns as either a list or a keyed object; keyed objects are ordered by integer turn_id key with lexical fallback forbidden.
Use the official README rule that any empty target reference means the prior query is not answerable or irrelevant; adjacent OOD dialogue acts define a descriptive no-answer subtype, not eligibility.

source.license_status: No explicit v0.9 license statement was found on the official page or archive link. Keep source ignored, publish no source text, retain attribution; related IBM HF v1.0.1 card says cc-by-3.0.

remaining_access_order: Freeze this v56 protocol and schema-corrected implementation before constructing any development case, query, candidate, decoy, neural score or metric.
Synthetically verify list and keyed turn containers, integer ordering, empty-reference semantics, OOD subtype, blind isolation, transferred mechanism and reports.
Register protocol, source, implementation, runner and test hashes before reopening wOOD train for outcome-bearing development preparation.
Build the development blind cache from the shared document and wOOD train members only; do not open wOOD dev.
Register sample commitments, census and runtime before deterministic queries or neural scoring.
Lock every own-document and decoy-document score before joining reference ids, answer state or OOD subtype.
Run all registered development gates once. Open wOOD dev exactly once only if every gate passes; otherwise publish the negative or null result and stop.
Never reuse revealed development cases for method, threshold, prompt, budget, decoy or support-check selection.

task_construction.target_turn: Each agent turn with an immediately preceding user turn.
task_construction.answer_bearing: Target agent references contains at least one mapped official span id.
task_construction.no_answer: Target agent references is empty, matching the official README's not-answerable-or-irrelevant semantics.

no_answer_subtypes.ood_act: Empty reference with adjacent user or agent dialogue act ending /ood.
no_answer_subtypes.other_empty: Empty reference without adjacent /ood; retained as no-answer under the official README and audited separately.

task_construction.schema_exclusion: Malformed ids, utterances, references, unmapped nonempty references or non-integer keyed turn containers are excluded and counted; rate above 0.01 fails development.
task_construction.forbidden_to_query_or_scorer: Dialogue acts, reference ids or labels, answer state or subtype, future turns, titles and raw source ids.

candidate_and_models.candidates: Every non-empty official document span, exact text and offsets, duplicate aliases collapsed without exposing labels.
candidate_and_models.own_retrieval_pool: BM25 Top-48 union BGE dense Top-48, at most 96.
candidate_and_models.probe_pool: BM25 Top-8 union BGE dense Top-8 per document, at most 16.

unchanged_queries.condition: Find prerequisites, eligibility requirements, conditions, or definitions needed to answer: {query}
unchanged_queries.solution: Find steps, benefits, outcomes, or direct answers that resolve: {query}
unchanged_queries.exception: Find exceptions, exclusions, deadlines, limitations, or cases where this does not apply: {query}

unchanged_decoys_gate_and_selector.decoys: Seven other documents: same-domain same-length-quartile first, then same-domain remainder, hash ordered with FRC-DOC2DIAL-WOOD-V56-DECOY; any other-domain fallback fails development.
unchanged_decoys_gate_and_selector.gate: Associated document must rank first among eight documents by maximum raw anchor reranker logit, giving p=1/8 under exchangeability.
unchanged_decoys_gate_and_selector.candidate: After gate pass, anchor Top-1 plus condition, solution and exception Top-1 only when each lies in anchor Top-3, deduplicated under budget.
unchanged_decoys_gate_and_selector.shared_gate_non_frc: BM25, dense, hybrid, cross-encoder Top-k and cross-encoder knapsack.
unchanged_decoys_gate_and_selector.ungated_controls: Frozen v43 adaptive argmax, v49 low-core and the five non-FRC controls.

scope_limits: English customer-service wOOD span selection only; not response generation, natural prevalence, official shared-task submission, SetR reproduction, flood-domain validation or rollout authorization.
